medicalDiscoveries.title: First Mizuna Harvest Metrics
medicalDiscoveries.finding: VEG-04 Mizuna mustard greens: 142 g ± 18 g fresh mass per pillow. 28-day cycle yields 0.57 kg, covering 35% of daily micronutrient needs.
medicalDiscoveries.source: NASA OSDR OSD-655 VEG-04 (ISS Flight-Mass.csv, N=8 valid pillows)

medicalDiscoveries.title: Blood Chemistry Panel Filed
medicalDiscoveries.finding: Serum calcium elevated 10.4 mg/dL (+13% vs baseline). BUN up 35% — hydration order: >2.5 L/day per crew member. BVAD water budget confirmed.
medicalDiscoveries.source: NASA OSDR OSD-575 (LSDS-8 CMP flight draw; BVAD NASA/TP-2015-218570)

medicalDiscoveries.title: Cytokine Inflammatory Ratio
medicalDiscoveries.finding: IL-6 elevated to 4.2 pg/mL (+133%). Overall inflammatory ratio 34% above baseline. Prescribing Rest & Recovery standing orders twice weekly.

medicalDiscoveries.title: Radiation Dose Review
medicalDiscoveries.finding: Cumulative exposure within Advisory Zone (<50 mSv). LRO CRaTER orbit baseline: 1.52 mSv/day unshielded. Regolith vault cuts to <0.08 mSv/day (>95% attenuation).
medicalDiscoveries.source: LRO CRaTER (Schwadron et al. 2012, Space Weather); RadLab ISS OSD-452

medicalDiscoveries.title: Hydroponics Nutrition Impact
medicalDiscoveries.finding: Fresh Mizuna greens: 48.2 mg vitamin C + 112 µmol anthocyanins per 100g. Radiation DNA damage scavenging active. Crew morale up. Kidney stone risk reduced.
medicalDiscoveries.source: NASA OSDR OSD-655 Master Chem (VEG-04 nutritional chemistry data)

medicalDiscoveries.title: Mission Health Summary
medicalDiscoveries.finding: 75-day cumulative health profile: bone loss within predicted range, IL-6 managed by rest schedule, vitamin C supply maintained. Crew cleared for final 15 days.
